title: Hoover letter calling Condon a Russian spy

tellings.quote: I believe it was, um, Jed Ghuber wrote a letter, um, to Congress.

plain: In 1949, FBI director J. Edgar Hoover is said to have written a letter to Congress calling the physicist Edward Condon, who later led a government study of UFOs, a Russian spy. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer, brings it up with Michels from memory ("I believe it was" Hoover, he says) as a point about the man later put in charge of judging UFOs.
